high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news website. The headline reads, "Will Mojtaba Khamenei be Iran’s New Supreme Leader?" The article discusses the challenges faced by Iranian leader Khamenei both domestically and internationally. It mentions that while Iranian security forces have managed to control protests and maintain order, years of Western sanctions have severely impacted the economy. The article cites a Reuters report suggesting that economic hardship could lead to unrest within the country.
